question: Should Twilio RCS become a bundled OpenClaw channel, or should it ship as an external ClawHub code plugin with only the minimal generic HTTP-route seam retained in core?
rationale: VISION.md and current plugin tooling support external channel plugins and set a high bar for optional commercial-service integrations, but the adjacent SMS channel is bundled and the contributor argues RCS is its carrier-driven successor; automation cannot choose that permanent support tier.

options.title: Externalize and split the core seam
options.body: Publish the RCS channel through ClawHub and move only the generic route-registration result plus justified SMS collision hardening into a narrow core change.

options.title: Sponsor the bundled channel
options.body: Accept RCS as a maintained bundled channel after dependency approval, lockfile cleanup, upgrade review, and redacted live Twilio proof.

options.title: Pause pending stronger demand
options.body: Keep the issue and PR inactive until maintainers have stronger adoption evidence or an owner willing to support the bundled integration.

recommendation.title: Externalize and split the core seam
recommendation.body: Publish the RCS channel through ClawHub and move only the generic route-registration result plus justified SMS collision hardening into a narrow core change.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent bundled SMS channel and its distribution/security precedent appear to originate from this person's merged work.
